answer: Give every identity a public lagoon of work: a visible pool of completed tasks that strangers actually reuse, and influence flows only from its depth. A fresh identity starts hollow, with an empty lagoon and zero weight, and must fill it task by task. One operator cannot fill a hundred lagoons with distinct verified work, so clones stay shallow; at the nadir of a fraud wave the network drains every lagoon below the depth line, revoking its influence until real work refills it. Fakes pay full labor per copy.
